text_block_list.text: Since we'd been training hard lately, I told her she could spend the day however she liked.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I'll use it however I please.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ruby! Good day.
Doing some self-training on your own?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Trainer gave me instructions
to spend the day as I please.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
"Use it however you like," huh...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me, something similar happened
to me back when I lived with my parents.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. The ambassador's flight has been delayed?
So the banquet is postponed, then...?"

text_block_list.name: Servant
text_block_list.text: We have been instructed to let you spend that time as you please.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Do as I please, you say?
If that is the case—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let us pray for the ambassadors' safety
while we await their arrival.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want to ensure I'm ready to welcome you immediately,
no matter when you choose to visit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...And like that,
I just answered whatever I thought in the moment.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I figured if the flight was delayed, the ambassadors would be in a tight spot, too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"And then, out of nowhere,
another servant jumped out from the shadows!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
They said, 'I underestimated you,'
and suddenly apologized to me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I hear your father was trying to test whether you had the makings of a member of such a prestigious family.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: They said they wanted to test how we would respond and act in an unexpected situation.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much for sharing such valuable insights.
It was extremely helpful.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ? Reference...?
In the evening, just as I was getting ready to head home, Daiichi Ruby came by.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As per your instructions, I analyzed my own abilities,
formulated a detailed plan, and executed it.
Allow me to present my report.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In order to thoroughly train the entire body in a short time,
I performed shuttle dashes on the slope with added weight.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'll be thorough with the post-training stretching and massages as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: There will be no disruption whatsoever to tomorrow's training.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That is all.
Thank you very much for this highly meaningful opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Instructions to 'use it as I see fit'
are a test of my self-analysis and management abilities."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am grateful for your fruitful instructions, which encourage not only physical but also mental discipline.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
At first, I took your instructions literally.
Without realizing the deeper intention behind them—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am thoroughly ashamed of myself.

It seems there's a massive misunderstanding going on...
However, correcting her here might ruin a valuable learning experience for her—
choice_data_list: I figured someone as exceptional in mind and body as you would notice.
I figured someone as exceptional in mind and body as you would notice.
I'll have to make it even harder next time.

text_block_list.text:
It seems there's a massive misunderstanding going on...
However, correcting her here might ruin a valuable learning experience for her—
choice_data_list: I figured someone as exceptional in mind and body as you would notice.
I figured someone as exceptional in mind and body as you would notice.
I'll have to make it even harder next time.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...It was thanks to Fine-san's advice that
I realized it. Though I'm not sure if
I lived up to expectations."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I intend to work hard so that I can notice these things on my own from next time onward.
I look forward to working with you."

I managed to avoid disappointing Daiichi Ruby.
However, I realized that next time, I need to give more specific instructions so she doesn't overthink things.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am also looking forward to your next move.

There's no backing down now...
But this is for her sake. I'll do my best
to come up with a great training regimen...!
